entries.description: ZFramework 资源包初始化、更新、下载与加载的底层资源管理包。
entries.descriptionEn: Underlying asset package used by ZFramework for initialization, updates, downloads, and loading.
constraints: 资源流程由 ZFramework 的 IResourceModule 与启动 Procedure 封装
constraintsEn: Asset workflows are wrapped by ZFramework IResourceModule and startup Procedures

entries.description: 为 AI 客户端提供 Unity Editor 自动化桥接。
entries.descriptionEn: Provides a Unity Editor automation bridge for AI clients.

entries.description: ZFramework 运行时模块的注册、获取、更新和关闭组合根。
entries.descriptionEn: Composition root for registering, resolving, updating, and shutting down ZFramework runtime modules.
entries.usageNotes: 业务代码获取已注册模块时优先使用 GameModule 缓存入口；仅组合根、启动注册和框架扩展代码直接调用 ModuleSystem.GetModule/RegisterModule。让 ModuleSystem 统一驱动 Update 与 Shutdown，不要建立平行模块容器。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use the cached GameModule entry points when game code resolves registered modules. Call ModuleSystem.GetModule/RegisterModule directly only from composition roots, startup registration, or framework extensions; let ModuleSystem own Update and Shutdown instead of creating a parallel module container.
constraints: 业务层优先通过 GameModule 缓存入口访问；组合根与启动注册代码可以直接使用 ModuleSystem
constraintsEn: Game code should use cached GameModule access; composition roots and startup registration may use ModuleSystem directly

entries.description: 基于 YooAsset 的资源包初始化、版本/清单更新、资源加载和引用释放模块。
entries.descriptionEn: YooAsset-based module for package initialization, version and manifest updates, asset loading, and reference release.
entries.usageNotes: 运行时资产统一通过 GameModule.Resource 访问；普通资产优先异步加载，GameObject 使用 LoadGameObjectAsync，并为非默认内容包显式传入 packageName。把取消令牌绑定到调用方生命周期，手动加载的 Asset 必须配对 UnloadAsset，实例与句柄也要按所有权及时释放。
entries.usageNotesEn: Route runtime assets through GameModule.Resource. Prefer asynchronous loading for ordinary assets, use LoadGameObjectAsync for GameObjects, and pass packageName explicitly for non-default content packages. Bind cancellation to the caller lifecycle and release manually loaded assets, instances, and handles according to ownership.
capabilities: 多运行模式资源初始化
constraints: 业务层通过 GameModule.Resource 访问
constraintsEn: LoadAssetAsync must be paired with release
Game code accesses it through GameModule.Resource

entries.description: 通过类型接口和 string/int 事件 ID 解耦模块的事件派发能力。
entries.descriptionEn: Event dispatch capability that decouples modules through typed interfaces and string/int event IDs.
entries.usageNotes: 跨模块的一对多通知使用 GameEvent；固定公共契约优先类型接口事件，确需动态路由时才使用稳定的 string/int ID。UI 内使用 AddUIEvent 让订阅随界面释放，其他订阅必须以同一委托显式移除；不要用事件总线代替请求返回或共享状态。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use GameEvent for one-to-many notifications across modules. Prefer typed interface events for stable public contracts and use stable string/int IDs only when dynamic routing is necessary. Inside UI code use AddUIEvent for lifecycle cleanup; elsewhere remove the same delegate explicitly, and do not use the event bus as request/response or shared state.
capabilities: UI 生命周期事件绑定
constraints: UI 内部事件使用 AddUIEvent 并随生命周期清理
constraintsEn: Use AddUIEvent inside UI and clean it up with the UI lifecycle

entries.description: 面向实现 IMemory 的纯 C# 对象复用与回收能力。
entries.descriptionEn: Reusable allocation and recycling for pure C# objects implementing IMemory.
entries.usageNotes: 只为高频、短生命周期且实现 IMemory 的纯 C# 对象使用 MemoryPool。获取后明确单一所有者，并在 finally 或等价清理路径中 Release；归还前清空可变状态，归还后不得访问或重复归还。长生命周期对象和 UnityEngine.Object 不使用该池。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use MemoryPool only for frequently allocated, short-lived pure C# objects that implement IMemory. Give each acquired object one clear owner and Release it from a finally block or equivalent cleanup path; reset mutable state before return and never access or release it twice afterward. Do not use this pool for long-lived objects or UnityEngine.Object instances.
constraints: Release 后不得继续访问对象
同一对象不得重复 Release
constraintsEn: Objects must not be accessed after Release
The same object must not be released twice

entries.description: 管理 Unity 游戏对象与自定义对象池实例、更新和释放的运行时模块。
entries.descriptionEn: Runtime module that manages creation, updates, and release of Unity and custom object pools.
entries.usageNotes: 对需要重复 Spawn/Unspawn 的 Unity 对象或 ObjectBase 对象使用 IObjectPoolModule；在组合根创建并复用命名池，按峰值设置容量与过期时间。归还前重置可变状态，场景或功能卸载时销毁对应池；低频且廉价的对象无需池化。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use IObjectPoolModule for Unity or ObjectBase instances that repeatedly Spawn and Unspawn. Create and reuse named pools at the composition root, sizing capacity and expiration for peak demand. Reset mutable state before return and destroy the relevant pool when its scene or feature unloads; do not pool cheap, infrequently created objects.
constraints: 对象归还后不得继续持有可变状态
constraintsEn: Mutable state must not be retained after an object is returned

entries.description: 纯 C# UIWindow/UIWidget 生命周期、层级、资源与事件协作框架。
entries.descriptionEn: Pure C# framework coordinating UIWindow/UIWidget lifecycles, layers, assets, and events.
entries.usageNotes: 完整界面继承 UIWindow，可复用局部继承 UIWidget，并统一通过 GameModule.UI 打开、关闭和查询。异步加载的取消与资源释放必须绑定窗口生命周期，界面事件使用 AddUIEvent；不要在业务代码中直接 Instantiate 窗口或长期持有已关闭界面引用。
entries.usageNotesEn: Derive full screens from UIWindow and reusable regions from UIWidget, then open, close, and query them through GameModule.UI. Tie asynchronous cancellation and resource release to the window lifecycle and register UI events through AddUIEvent; do not instantiate windows directly in game code or retain references after closure.
capabilities: UI 层级与全屏窗口管理
capabilitiesEn: UI layers and full-screen window management
constraints: 窗口资源和事件必须随生命周期释放
constraintsEn: Window assets and events must be released with the lifecycle

entries.description: Luban 生成配置的同步、异步与懒加载接入边界。当前检出仅保留 LubanLib，ConfigSystem 生成代码尚未落盘。
entries.descriptionEn: Integration boundary for synchronous, asynchronous, and lazy loading of Luban-generated configuration. This checkout contains LubanLib only; generated ConfigSystem code is absent.
entries.usageNotes: 仅在 ConfigSystem 与 GameConfig 生成输出存在后使用该能力，并把生成入口作为配置查询的唯一边界。启动必需表可异步预加载，非关键表按需懒加载；二进制配置通过 ResourceModule 和明确的 packageName 读取。不得手改生成代码，输出缺失时应重新生成而不是另建并行解析器。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use this capability only after the generated ConfigSystem and GameConfig output exists, and treat the generated entry point as the sole configuration-query boundary. Asynchronously preload startup-critical tables and lazily load optional ones; read binary data through ResourceModule with an explicit packageName. Never hand-edit generated code, and regenerate missing output instead of building a parallel parser.
capabilities: Luban 表结构与代码生成
constraints: 当前代码核验状态为 partial：使用前必须先生成或恢复 ConfigSystem 与 GameConfig 输出
生成代码属于普通 Player 程序集
constraintsEn: Verified as partial: generate or restore ConfigSystem and GameConfig output before use
Generated code belongs to ordinary Player assemblies

entries.description: 基于 FSM 的启动流程注册、切换与逐帧生命周期模块。
entries.descriptionEn: FSM-based module for startup procedure registration, transitions, and per-frame lifecycle execution.
entries.usageNotes: 用于互斥、粗粒度且具有明确 Enter/Update/Leave 生命周期的流程状态；在组合根注册完整 Procedure 集合，并通过 GameModule.Procedure 启动和切换。状态只负责阶段编排与交接，不用于并行子系统、短暂 UI 导航或通用事件广播；启动顺序遵循 zframework-startup-lifecycle。
entries.usageNotesEn: Use ProcedureModule for mutually exclusive, coarse-grained states with explicit Enter/Update/Leave lifecycles. Register the complete Procedure set at the composition root and start or transition through GameModule.Procedure. Keep states focused on stage orchestration and handoff, not parallel subsystems, transient UI navigation, or general event broadcasting; follow zframework-startup-lifecycle for startup ordering.
capabilities: 进入/更新/离开生命周期
constraints: 可复用启动顺序由 zframework-startup-lifecycle Architecture 定义
constraintsEn: The reusable startup sequence is defined by the zframework-startup-lifecycle Architecture

entries.description: 从组合根初始化框架模块，经可替换的 Procedure 状态链完成资源准备，再进入业务扩展点的可复用启动生命周期。具体项目 UI、内容包和 GameApp 逻辑不是该架构契约的一部分。
entries.descriptionEn: Reusable startup lifecycle that initializes framework modules at the composition root, prepares assets through replaceable Procedure states, and enters a game extension point. Project UI, content packages, and GameApp logic are outside this architecture contract.
constraints: Architecture 阶段只定义顺序与扩展点，不固化项目 UI 文案、内容包名称或具体 GameApp 行为
联机资源模式需完成清单与下载流程后进入内容包阶段
constraintsEn: Architecture stages define ordering and extension points without fixing project UI text, package names, or concrete GameApp behavior
Online asset modes complete manifest and download stages before content package initialization

entries.description: 当前项目把 Launcher UI、更新设置、内容包流程和 GameApp 业务入口接入通用启动生命周期的组合实现。
entries.descriptionEn: Project-specific composition that connects Launcher UI, update settings, content-package flow, and the GameApp entry point to the reusable startup lifecycle.
constraints: 项目 UI 文案、包名称和首个业务界面只属于该项目接入，不得写入通用启动生命周期契约
GameApp.Entrance 只在 ProcedureStartGame 进入后调用
constraintsEn: Project UI text, package names, and the first game screen belong to this integration and must not enter the reusable lifecycle contract
GameApp.Entrance is invoked only after entering ProcedureStartGame
